# Project Vocabulary
<!-- Generated by /monolith. Append-only on re-run. Hand edits are preserved. -->

## Domain Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **DeeGee** | The browser workflow product spanning skills, CLI, shared types, and extension. _src:_ README.md |
| **dg-skills** | The command-line tool that opens browser workflows and moves their files. _src:_ pkg/skills-cli/src/index.ts |
| **dg-ai-extension** | The companion extension that groups tabs, plays tours, records, and prototypes. _src:_ pkg/extension/README.md |
| **@dg/common** | The shared package for workflow types, validation, parsing, and serialization. _src:_ pkg/common/src/index.ts |
| **Browser batch** | A set of URLs opened together with one requested group name. _src:_ pkg/skills-cli/src/pw/tab-verbs.ts |
| **Marked tab** | A tab whose URL fragment carries a DeeGee workflow marker. _src:_ pkg/extension/lib/features/tab-grouping.ts |
| **Tab group** | A browser-native group created from marked tabs sharing one name. _src:_ pkg/extension/lib/features/tab-grouping.ts |
| **Guided tour** | A reviewed sequence of spotlights, navigation, and actions played on a live page. (avoid: demo) _src:_ plugins/dg/skills/demo/SKILL.md |
| **Tour plan** | A durable Markdown description that compiles into a runnable tour script. (avoid: plan) _src:_ pkg/common/src/plan-format.ts |

## Naming Conventions

| Term | Pattern |
|------|---------|
| **Package scope** | Shared workspace packages use the `@dg/` prefix. _src:_ pkg/common/package.json |
| **Fragment marker keys** | Workflow fragment keys start with an underscore. _src:_ pkg/skills-cli/src/utils/marker.ts |
| **Extension messages** | Cross-context message names use `dg-feature:action`. _src:_ pkg/extension/lib/features/prototype.ts |
| **Feature registrars** | Background listener modules expose `registerFeature` functions. _src:_ pkg/extension/lib/background/index.ts |
| **Injectable dependencies** | Test-controlled dependency types end in `Deps` or `Seams`. _src:_ pkg/extension/lib/background/recording.ts |

## Architectural Patterns

| Term | Summary |
|------|---------|
| **Fragment handoff** | The CLI puts local payloads in URL fragments that the extension strips. _src:_ pkg/skills-cli/src/utils/proto-marker.ts |
| **Downloads handoff** | Extension downloads move browser results back to the waiting CLI. _src:_ pkg/skills-cli/src/commands/proto.ts |
| **Inert content script** | The all-page content script stays idle without a marker or active tour. _src:_ pkg/extension/entrypoints/demo-tour.content.ts |
| **Serial queue** | Marker-driven tab work runs in order and continues after failures. _src:_ pkg/common/src/serial-queue.ts |

## Concepts

| Term | Summary |
|------|---------|
| **TourScript** | The validated runtime contract shared by the CLI and extension. _src:_ pkg/common/src/types.ts |
| **TourStep** | One authored spotlight, navigation, or action within a tour. _src:_ pkg/common/src/types.ts |

Additional low-frequency terms live in [domain references](references/domain.md).

## Relationships

- One **Browser batch** contains one or more **Marked tabs** for one **Tab group**.
- One **Tour plan** compiles into exactly one **TourScript**.
- One **TourScript** contains one or more **TourStep** entries and optional **TourSetup**.
- One **ProtoPlan** contains one to five **ProtoVariation** entries.
- One approving **Verdict** selects exactly one **ProtoVariation** for the **Prototype answer**.

## Flagged Ambiguities

- **Plan** means either **Tour plan** or **ProtoPlan**. Name the exact form.
- **Selected** means previewed; **approved** means an approving **Verdict** exists. Keep those states distinct.
- **Recording** can mean active capture, pending IndexedDB data, or **Recording bundle**. Name the stage.
- **Cleanup** removes temporary prototype files but preserves the **Prototype answer**. Say temporary cleanup.
